rows.quote: performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each.
rows.reason_zh: 一次施放仍会攻击范围内的所有敌人，并分别造成额外伤害。

rows.quote: Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.
rows.reason_zh: 所有被击中的敌人仍会受到减速。

rows.quote: item_cost: 2100→2000；hp_regen_amp: 12→16
rows.reason_zh: 本次只调整价格和生命回复增幅，原有的装备减速抗性判断仍成立。

rows.quote: movement_speed_percent_bonus: 12→10；movement_speed_percent_bonus_melee: 12→10
rows.reason_zh: 两项移速加成都降至10%，装备仍提供加速。

rows.quote: movement_speed_percent_bonus: 12→10；movement_speed_percent_bonus_melee: 12→10
rows.reason_zh: 下调的是自身移速加成，变更字段中没有减速抗性调整。

rows.quote: item_cost: 4200→4000；hp_regen_amp: 16→20；movement_speed_percent_bonus: 12→10；movement_speed_percent_bonus_melee: 12→10
rows.reason_zh: 价格、生命回复增幅和移速加成的调整均未改变原有的状态抗性判断。

rows.quote: DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍以弱驱散移除友方目标身上的负面效果。

rows.quote: At the end of the duration, the unit is healed.
rows.reason_zh: 效果结束时仍会治疗目标。

rows.quote: DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍以弱驱散移除敌方目标身上的正面效果。

rows.quote: Causes Demonic Purge to break and gain %max_charges% charges.
rows.reason_zh: A杖升级仍使邪恶净化对目标施加破坏。

rows.quote: gain %max_charges% charges.
rows.reason_zh: A杖升级仍赋予技能充能。

rows.quote: The slow starts at %max_slow%%% and decreases over time to %min_slow%%%.
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍施加减速，且减速幅度随时间降低。

rows.quote: Purges the target enemy unit
rows.reason_zh: 施放时仍可选择一个敌方单位为目标。

rows.quote: total_chickens: 1→3
rows.reason_zh: 本次增加了鸡的数量，没有加入对多个敌人造成伤害的效果。

rows.quote: When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel
rows.reason_zh: 受到致命伤害并触发禽戏时，暗影萨满仍会获得强驱散。

rows.quote: total_chickens: 1→3
rows.reason_zh: 唯一变更是鸡的数量，决定可破坏性的 IsBreakable 字段没有变更，沿用原判。

rows.quote: Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.
rows.reason_zh: 暗影萨满复活时仍会立即刷新禽戏的冷却。

rows.quote: Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration
rows.reason_zh: 基础效果仍会在短时间内将受到的伤害降至零。

rows.quote: When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken
rows.reason_zh: 符合触发条件的致命伤害仍会让暗影萨满以1点生命存活，说明列出的致命伤害例外仍适用。

rows.quote: Lethal Damage from Axe's Culling Blade and Necrophos's Reaper's Scythe will not be prevented.
rows.reason_zh: 这条说明列出禽戏无法阻止的致命伤害，禽戏自身没有按生命阈值击杀目标的效果。

rows.quote: survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed.
rows.reason_zh: 暗影萨满变鸡后仍获得移动速度加成。

rows.quote: Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed.
rows.reason_zh: 这里描述的是暗影萨满触发保命后的自身形态，没有加入对目标施加妖术的效果。

rows.quote: Incoming damage reduction buff will prevent certain sources of HP removal from killing Shadow Shaman.
rows.reason_zh: 禽戏能阻止部分生命移除来源致死，技能本身没有直接移除生命的效果。

rows.quote: When Fowl Play is triggered, Shadow Shaman becomes invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds.
rows.reason_zh: 无敌的适用条件应校正为魔晶（shard_upgrade），两版都将无敌写在魔晶说明中，基础说明只写短暂减伤至零。

rows.quote: Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.
rows.reason_zh: 复活只负责触发冷却刷新，禽戏本身没有使暗影萨满复活或改变复活过程的效果。

rows.quote: Summons %ward_count% Serpent Wards to attack enemy units and structures.
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍通过蛇棒分别攻击敌方单位或建筑，变更没有赋予施放或单次攻击范围伤害。

rows.quote: The Wards are immune to magic.
rows.reason_zh: 基础说明仍明确赋予蛇棒技能免疫。

rows.quote: ward_health: 4→2
rows.reason_zh: 蛇棒的生命格数下调，巨蟒之瓮的新版说明也明确基础蛇棒使用格数生命，仍符合召唤物词条的排除条件。

new_mechanisms.quote: Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to the Serpent Ward.
new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 7.42新增了蛇棒对幻象来源的减伤，幻象只造成25%伤害，小兵来源的减伤在旧版已经存在。

rows.quote: Throw a snake jar at the target location, damaging all enemies in the AoE
rows.reason_zh: 投瓮仍对落点范围内的所有敌人造成伤害。

rows.quote: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless creature, disabling their attacks and abilities.
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍将敌方单位变成无害生物并封住攻击和技能，本次只降低了魔耗。

rows.quote: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless creature
rows.reason_zh: 妖术仍以一个敌方单位为施放目标。

rows.quote: Emits a freezing wave that deals %blast_damage% magical damage to enemies
rows.reason_zh: 主动释放的冰波仍能对范围内多个敌人造成魔法伤害。

rows.quote: Reduces the attack speed of all enemies by %aura_attack_speed%.
rows.reason_zh: 被动光环仍降低范围内所有敌人的攻击速度。

rows.quote: Passive: Freezing Aura Reduces the attack speed of all enemies by %aura_attack_speed%. Radius: %aura_radius%
rows.reason_zh: 装备仍通过被动光环持续影响持有者周围的敌人。

rows.quote: blast_movement_speed: -40→-30
rows.reason_zh: 冰波的移速减幅由40%降至30%，仍会使敌人减速。

rows.quote: blast_movement_speed: -40→-30
rows.reason_zh: 新版冰波仍降低敌人30%的移速，这条减速判断也成立。

rows.quote: it will spin in place, dealing damage in an area around it.
rows.reason_zh: 飞轮仍对周围区域造成伤害，各级调整后的伤害均大于零。

rows.quote: at the target location where it will spin in place, dealing damage in an area around it.
rows.reason_zh: 飞轮仍在指定地点持续旋转，对留在区域内的敌人生效。

rows.quote: Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every %slow_health_percentage%%% of health missing.
rows.reason_zh: 处于飞轮中的敌人仍会按已损失生命比例受到减速。

rows.quote: cuts down trees in its path when fired and retracted.
rows.reason_zh: 飞轮在发射和收回时仍会摧毁沿途树木。
本次只变更了 behavior，决定可破坏性的 IsBreakable 字段没有变更，沿用原判。

rows.quote: Whenever Timbersaw destroys a tree, he gains mana.
rows.reason_zh: 伐木机摧毁树木时仍会为自身恢复法力。

rows.quote: Whenever Timbersaw destroys a tree, he gains mana.
rows.reason_zh: 摧毁树木是触发回蓝的条件，技能自身没有获得砍树效果。

rows.quote: damaging enemies and destroying trees around him in an area.
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍可伤害伐木机周围的多个敌人，每棵树的额外伤害下调不影响范围伤害判断。

rows.quote: destroying trees around him in an area.
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍会摧毁伐木机周围的树木。

rows.quote: Intelligence Steal is not disabled by Break.
rows.reason_zh: 新增说明只确认偷取智力不受破坏，材料未给出 IsBreakable 的值，也未说明破坏对伤害增减部分的影响，无法独立确认整项技能均不受破坏。

rows.quote: Silencer takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.
rows.reason_zh: 沉默术士受到来自已沉默目标的伤害仍会降低。

rows.quote: Silencer takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.
rows.reason_zh: 已沉默目标承受来自沉默术士的伤害仍会增加，说明没有限定伤害类型。

rows.quote: If the victim was silenced, steal an extra %silenced_bonus_int_steal_amount% Intelligence.
rows.reason_zh: 目标已被沉默是额外偷智的条件，技能自身没有施加沉默的效果。

rows.quote: Silencer permanently steals %permanent_int_steal_amount% Intelligence from them.
rows.reason_zh: 敌方英雄满足死亡条件时，沉默术士仍会永久偷取其智力。

rows.quote: Causes Glaives of Wisdom to bounce %bounce_count% time to a random enemy within %bounce_range% range
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶仍使智慧之刃弹射至其他敌人，一次攻击可以伤害多个目标。

rows.quote: stealing his target's Intelligence with each hit and dealing additional damage based on his Intelligence.
rows.reason_zh: 每次命中仍附带偷取智力和基于自身智力的额外伤害。

rows.quote: stealing his target's Intelligence with each hit and dealing additional damage based on his Intelligence.
rows.reason_zh: 命中效果仍为偷智和额外伤害，此次调整没有加入沉默。

rows.quote: stealing his target's Intelligence with each hit
rows.reason_zh: 基础攻击命中时仍偷取目标智力，本次提高的是魔晶提供的偷取量。

rows.quote: int_steal.shard: 1→2
rows.reason_zh: 唯一变更是魔晶偷智数值，基础技能原有的敌方单位指向判断仍成立。

rows.quote: disable their passive abilities for %backstab_duration% seconds
rows.reason_zh: 以攻击结束隐身时仍会暂时禁用目标的被动技能。

rows.quote: Attacking to end the invisibility will deal %windwalk_bonus_damage% bonus physical damage
rows.reason_zh: 结束隐身的那次攻击仍附带额外物理伤害。

rows.quote: windwalk_movement_speed: 20→18
rows.reason_zh: 隐身期间的移速加成降至18%，持有者仍获得加速。

rows.quote: Makes you invisible for %windwalk_duration% seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell.
rows.reason_zh: 主动使用装备仍使持有者进入隐身。

rows.quote: While invisible, you move %windwalk_movement_speed%%% faster and can move through units.
rows.reason_zh: 持有者在隐身期间仍能穿过其他单位。

rows.quote: cap their movement speed to %max_movement_speed%.
rows.reason_zh: 破隐攻击仍会限制目标的移速上限，目标原先超过上限时就会被减速。

rows.quote: Passive: Cold Attack Attacks lower enemy movement
rows.reason_zh: 装备仍使普通攻击附带降低敌人移速的效果。

rows.quote: Attacks also lower enemy attack speed by %cold_attack_slow_melee%%%
rows.reason_zh: 寒冷攻击仍会降低敌人的攻击速度。

rows.quote: Attacks also lower enemy attack speed by %cold_attack_slow_melee%%% and Health Restoration by %restoration_reduction%%%.
rows.reason_zh: 攻击命中后仍会削减敌人的生命恢复。

rows.quote: cold_slow_melee: -25→-20；cold_slow_ranged: -50→-40
rows.reason_zh: 对近战和远程敌人的移速减幅分别降至20%和40%，两类目标仍会被减速。

rows.quote: Activate to spend all charges, summoning skeletons that respawn once when killed.
rows.reason_zh: 主动施放仍用于召唤骷髅，变更没有赋予施放或骷髅单次攻击范围伤害。

rows.quote: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
rows.reason_zh: 破坏仍会阻止获得新层数，符合技能部分效果可被破坏的定义。

rows.quote: Activate to spend all charges, summoning skeletons
rows.reason_zh: 施放一次会耗尽积累的层数以召唤骷髅，不符合每次使用消耗一点的充能定义。

rows.quote: Skeletons benefit from Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal.
rows.reason_zh: 骷髅享受的吸血来自吸血之魂，白骨护卫自身没有提供吸血。

rows.quote: skeletons that respawn once when killed.
rows.reason_zh: 召出的骷髅被击杀后仍能复活一次。

rows.quote: summoning skeletons that respawn once when killed.
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍会召出可被击杀和复活的骷髅单位。

rows.quote: Wraith King sears an enemy unit with spectral fire, dealing damage and stunning, then dealing damage over time and slowing the target.
rows.reason_zh: 初始伤害和后续持续伤害都作用于同一个目标，此次只延长了眩晕。

rows.quote: then dealing damage over time and slowing the target.
rows.reason_zh: 初始眩晕后仍会减速目标。
各级眩晕持续时间均延长了0.2秒，眩晕机制仍成立。

rows.quote: Wraith King sears an enemy unit with spectral fire
rows.reason_zh: 冥火爆击仍可选择一个敌方单位为施放目标。

rows.quote: causing it to take additional damage from spells.
rows.reason_zh: 说明将增伤限定为技能伤害，未赋予针对物理伤害或全部伤害的加深效果。
各级魔抗削减幅度均下调，但仍能降低适用目标的魔抗。

rows.quote: silencing it and causing it to take additional damage from spells.
rows.reason_zh: 上古封印仍会沉默目标。

rows.quote: Skywrath Mage seals the targeted unit with an ancient rune, silencing it
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍可选择一个敌方单位施加封印。
